item.title: Some of the best Simply Smashed R&D still happens in my mum's back garden. Family BBQ a fe…
item.description:
Some of the best Simply Smashed R&D still happens in my mum's back garden.
Family BBQ a few weeks ago (rip summer, feels like it ended the second we packed the grill away) and half of it quietly turned into a taste test.
New patties on the grill, a couple of sauces we've been messing with, everyone chewing and giving their verdict whether you asked for it or not.
One of them was the New Yorker, a pastrami smash we'd been arguing over for weeks.
It's been selling out on repeat since.
This is genuinely how a lot of it still works. Not a lab, not a focus group.
A grill in the garden and a family that'll tell you straight when something's rubbish.
What's the best thing you've ever had off a family BBQ?
